message: I love waking up to soft morning light—it’s such a gentle reminder to appreciate the little things. Just like my trusty smoke detector up there, quietly doing its job while I sip my coffee. It's nice to know that some things are always reliable, especially when tech can be so temperamental! ☕ What little habits bring you comfort in your home?
scene: a smoke detector on a bedroom ceiling in soft morning light (golden-hour light through a window)
